$comment: Recreate-this-sound drills. Values are S-1 CC numbers → 0–127 (see midi.json). 'start' is sent by 'Set up the start' on top of baseStart; 'target' is what the player should reach. compare: 'cycle' = harmonic levels of the held note, 'envelope' = loudness over time.

drills.title: Hollow square
drills.goal: Swap the bright sawtooth for a hollow square wave.
drills.listen: Hollower and more woodwind-like than the saw.
drills.look: Flat tops and bottoms joined by vertical edges.

drills.title: Saw meets square
drills.goal: Start from the square wave and blend the sawtooth in with it.
drills.listen: Brighter and buzzier than the square alone, but still a little hollow.
drills.look: The square's flat tops and bottoms tilt into ramps.

drills.title: Square with sub
drills.goal: A square wave with the sub oscillator adding weight an octave down.
drills.listen: Fuller bass under the same note.
drills.look: Alternating tall and short steps: the sub repeats every two cycles of the square.

drills.title: Saw with weight
drills.goal: Keep the saw and bring the sub oscillator in underneath.
drills.look: The ramps alternate between higher and lower positions.

drills.title: Round off the saw
drills.goal: Turn the cutoff (FREQ) down until the saw loses its buzz.
drills.listen: Darker and softer, like a muted brass.
drills.look: The sharp drop of the saw becomes a rounded curve.

drills.title: Almost a sine
drills.goal: Start from a square wave and filter it until only the fundamental is left.
drills.look: A smooth, sine-like wave with no corners.

drills.title: Resonant saw
drills.goal: Lower the cutoff a little and raise the resonance (RESO).
drills.listen: A nasal, whistling peak on top of the saw.
drills.look: Ripples ringing after each drop of the saw.

drills.title: Squelchy square
drills.goal: A square wave through a low cutoff with high resonance.
drills.look: Big ringing wiggles after every edge of the square.

drills.title: Pluck
drills.goal: Make each note start loud and die away: short decay, no sustain.
drills.listen: A plucked string or a mallet.
drills.look: The loudness curve jumps up, then falls to silence.

drills.title: Slow swell
drills.goal: Fade each note in slowly, hold it, then let it ring out.
drills.listen: Like a bowed string or a pad.
drills.look: A gentle ramp up, a flat top, then a tail after the note ends.

drills.title: Organ gate
drills.goal: Starting from a pluck, make the note sound fully for exactly as long as it's held.
drills.listen: An organ: instant on, instant off.
drills.look: A rectangle: straight up, flat, straight down.
